title: On a classical zero-sum invariant II: Disproof of a long-standing conjecture — theorem thm:main2
author: Alfred Geroldinger; Guoqing Wang; Wenkai Yang
work: On a classical zero-sum invariant II: Disproof of a long-standing conjecture
difficulty_reason: The counted theorem determines the group invariant nu(G) for C2^r plus C6, r=5,6. Its non-routine obligation is to construct a zero-sum-free rank-five sequence whose missing subsequence sums force every proposed proper-coset obstruction to contain all generators. The author then lifts the construction to rank six while preserving a missing sum in the obstructing subgroup and its disjoint coset. Known exact Davenport constants are named prerequisites; the missing-sum construction and coset contradiction remain proved in this item, supporting H2 rather than a length-based H3 label.
